correctness.rationale: Dyadic units decompose as +/- 5^j; for even k with s=v2(k), kth powers of odd units have exactly 2^(s+1) preimages on 1+2^(s+2) modulo every 2^r with r>=s+2. Exhaustive parity cases establish an exact geometric Haar mixture. They separately yield all three finite-fiber branches, the both-even 2^(2k-2) recursion, and the r=1/r<h exceptions. Standalone all-residue enumeration corroborates k=4,6,8,10,12,14,20 for r<=10; tests are not extrapolated to infinity.

value.rationale: A complete exact local representation statistic for a natural diagonal Waring form, simultaneously for all even k>=4, all dyadic moduli and all target residues, fills a real gap left by image-cardinality studies. The result gives a structural law with geometric valuations, nonuniform shell-dependent densities, and a full local probability measure, rather than merely finite examples, one residue class, or a repetition of an alpha table. Its use is in exact singular/local representation distributions; other primes and integer representations remain unclaimed.
